function.name: set_lights_power
function.description: Turn a room's lights on or off (switch on, switch off, turn out).

room.description: The room whose lights change: living room (lounge), kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, hallway (hall), study, whole house (every room, all the lights), or this room (the room the user is in).

function.name: set_lights_brightness
function.description: Set a room's lights to a brightness percentage from 1 to 100 (full or max is 100, half is 50).

room.description: The room whose lights change: living room (lounge), kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, hallway (hall), study, whole house (every room, all the lights), or this room (the room the user is in).

brightness.description: brightness in percent, a whole number from 1 to 100

function.name: set_lights_color
function.description: Change the colour of a room's lights.

room.description: The room whose lights change: living room (lounge), kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, hallway (hall), study, whole house (every room, all the lights), or this room (the room the user is in).

color.description: the colour: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple (violet), pink, white, warm white (warm, soft white), cool white (cool, daylight)

function.name: control_vacuum
function.description: Start the robot vacuum (roomba, hoover) cleaning, stop it, or send it back to its dock.

action.description: start cleaning, stop, or dock (go back to its base)

room.description: the room to clean when starting: living room, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, hallway, study, whole house, or this room

function.name: set_plug_power
function.description: Switch the smart plug (socket, outlet, wemo) on or off.

function.name: set_heating
function.description: Set the heating (thermostat) to a temperature in degrees Celsius.

function.name: set_blinds
function.description: Open or close the blinds (shades, curtains).

function.name: lock_front_door
function.description: Lock or unlock the front door.

function.name: start_coffee
function.description: Make a coffee with the coffee machine.

function.name: set_fan_speed
function.description: Set the ceiling fan speed.

function.name: set_tv_power
function.description: Switch the TV (television) on or off.

function.name: set_speaker_volume
function.description: Set the speaker volume in percent.

function.name: arm_alarm_system
function.description: Arm or disarm the home security system.

function.name: open_garage
function.description: Open or close the garage door.

function.name: water_garden
function.description: Water the garden for a number of minutes.

function.name: start_dishwasher
function.description: Start the dishwasher on a programme.

function.name: set_oven
function.description: Heat the oven to a temperature in degrees Celsius.

function.name: feed_pet
function.description: Dispense food from the pet feeder.

function.name: set_humidifier
function.description: Switch the humidifier on or off.

function.name: play_doorbell_camera
function.description: Show the doorbell camera on a screen.
